round1: Ryan opened with 28 points and led from this point on, nailing Tampa and Boston and Pittsburgh in six. Stephanie picked all eight series in six games and, as she has twice before, did not exactly cash in. Jamie finished with 4. Marc picked all eight winning teams but still came in third with 18.
round2: Glenda and Ryan tied for the round high at 16, and Ryan kept the lead. Robin picked all four series in four games and scored 4. Jaclyn scored 2 and was the only one to take Boston, Pittsburgh and San Jose in the same round.
round3: Benedict, Glenda and Ryan tied at 15, and Ryan stretched his lead to 59. Nathan and Robin both scored zero. Glenda was the only one to nail Vegas in five.
round4: Only Glenda took Vegas, and she only got 5 for the team and none for the game count. Derrick, Jaclyn, Jake and Marc picked Washington and got 4 each. Ryan had a 59 point lead built through three rounds and picked the wrong Cup winner anyway.
overall: Ryan won for the first time in his sixth year, 11 points clear of Glenda (48), after leading from the end of Round 1 onward. He also picked the wrong Cup winner for the fourth year in a row. Jaclyn and Jake picked the right Cup winner for the fourth year in a row, though Jaclyn finished 10th. Robin finished last for the first time with 12, and Jamie has now finished in the bottom three three years in a row.
